role: HealthKit + archive training queries: VO2max, workout fetch/dedup, archive-authoritative merge, workout route recovery, passive distance, resting HR, ATL/CTL/TSB metrics and weekly training load.

flags.text: mergeArchiveAuthoritative / collapseDuplicates (the archive-vs-HealthKit precedence rule) have no direct test; WorkoutDeduplicationTests covers deduplicateWorkouts only.

units.does: Queries all VO2max samples in the last `days` days ascending by end date (bounded) and returns latest, oldest and count.

branches.cond: HealthKit unavailable or vo2Max type nil

branches.effect: window start falls back to now (empty window)

units.does: Converts samples to ml/kg*min values; nil when none.
Sorts summaries by start and collapses those describing the same session, keeping the richest copy of each cluster.

flags.text: Doc says both rules are required with start times within 5 minutes, but collapseDuplicates scans up to 30 min and merges any overlap >=60 % regardless of start gap.

units.does: From index i, absorbs later summaries starting within 30 min of the current best that are same-type within 5 min or overlap >=60 % of the shorter; keeps the higher data score.

flags.text: The same-type rule needs no time overlap: two genuinely separate same-type workouts starting <=5 min apart (e.g. a 2-minute aborted start then a restart) collapse into one and the lower-scoring one's load is dropped from ATL/CTL; mergeArchiveAuthoritative feeds archive workouts through this while asserting archive workouts never duplicate each other.
The 30-min gap and the comparisons use `best.date`, which moves when a later copy wins, so cluster membership depends on processing order.

units.does: Keeps every archive workout, drops HealthKit workouts overlapping any archive workout by >=60 %, then dedups archive + remaining HealthKit + additional.
End date = start + durationMinutes*60.
True when the time intersection is >= 60 % of the shorter workout's duration.
Data-richness score: precomputedLoad 8, averageHR 4, maxHR 2, calories 1.
Recent workouts (default 7 days) via fetchWorkouts.
Bounded HKSampleQuery for workouts starting from start-of-day minus `days` to referenceDate (strict start), newest first, mapped to deduplicated summaries; [] on any failure/timeout.
Casts samples to HKWorkout, builds summaries (dropping <1 min) and dedups.
Summary from HKWorkout (start, type, minutes, active kcal, avg/max HR); nil when shorter than 1 minute.
Sum of the workout's activeEnergyBurned statistics in kcal.
Average and max HR (bpm) from the workout's heartRate statistics.
Recovers a GPS route for [start,end] from the best overlapping HealthKit workout's route series, sorted by timestamp.
Bounded query for workouts within [start-15min, end+15min] and picks preferredWorkout.
Among workouts >= 60 s, prefers those from other sources (e.g. Apple Watch) and returns the longest.

branches.effect: use all usable (own copies); returns nil if none

flags.text: preferredWorkout picks the LONGEST external workout anywhere in the ±15 min padded window without checking that it overlaps [start,end]; a separate, longer Apple Watch workout that ended up to 15 min before the session (or began up to 15 min after it) wins, and recoverRouteFromAppleWatch then rebuilds the session with that other workout's route and distance.

units.does: Bounded query for the workout's HKWorkoutRoute samples; returns the first.
Bounded HKWorkoutRouteQuery collecting all CLLocations; [] on error or timeout.
Builds an HKWorkoutRouteQuery whose handler accumulates batches under a lock and resolves once on done; resolves nil on error.

branches.effect: return; else resolve with full accumulation

units.does: Appends a batch under the lock and returns the whole accumulation exactly once when done.

branches.effect: nil; else mark resumed and return accumulation

units.does: Bounded HKStatisticsQuery cumulative sum of distanceWalkingRunning in [start,end] (strict start) excluding this app's own samples; 0 on failure.
Bounded limit-1 query for any workout starting in [start,end]; false on failure/timeout.
True when samples non-empty; logs that a sleep merge is skipped.
Extended workouts (default 60 days) via fetchWorkouts.
Latest-ever Apple resting heart rate (no date bound); records it into WorkoutLoadRestingHR.

flags.text: latestQuantityValue uses predicate nil, so the 'Apple resting HR' that anchors every HR-only TRIMP (trainingHeartRateAnchors) is the most recent sample ever recorded, however old; a user who stopped wearing an Apple Watch months ago gets that stale value instead of their resting-HR setting, shifting all HR-based training load.

units.does: Latest-ever VO2max value (ml/kg*min).
Bounded limit-1 newest-first sample query with no predicate; returns its value in unit.
Resolves HR anchors, merges archive+HealthKit workouts over 180 days, builds daily TRIMP, runs the EWMA through yesterday (morning) or today, and adds VO2max fields.
Anchors = Apple resting HR (latest) else settings effectiveRestingHR; max = settings effectiveMaxHR.
Uses caller anchors; resolves any nil one via trainingHeartRateAnchors.

branches.effect: nil inputs filled from resolved anchors

units.does: Builds TrainingMetrics: today's TRIMP, EWMA point through last day, today's and last-14-day workouts.
Gets HealthKit workouts (preloaded or 180-day fetch) and archive summaries (detached task) and merges archive-authoritatively with additional workouts.
Last `days` of HealthKit + archive workouts merged archive-authoritatively.
Workouts from the last 14 days, newest first.
Sets vo2MaxLatest and, when a trend exists, 30-day change and sample count.
Daily load buckets from (ewmaEnd - 179 days) through today using TrainingLoadSeries.dailyLoad; logs load sources.
Logs how many in-window workouts are power-backed.
Weekly TrainingLoad: merged recent workouts, VO2max + trend, anchors, ATL/CTL metrics, then intensity score, days since hard and ACWR; adds VO2 trend.

flags.text: fetchVO2Max and fetchVO2MaxTrend are queried here and again inside calculateTrainingMetrics -> applyVO2Max, doubling the HealthKit VO2 queries per call.

recentMergedWorkouts(days: 7) fetches from start-of-day minus 7 days through now (both fetchWorkouts and fromAppArchive), i.e. up to 8 calendar days, but trainingLoad normalises the intensity sum by `days` (7) and TrainingLoad documents recentWorkouts as 'Last 7 days', so the weekly load score can include an eighth day.

units.does: Builds TrainingLoad: weekly score = min(sum intensityScore / days * 7, 100), daysSinceHardWorkout, ACWR from metrics.
